target_contract: Same causal bid at origin and exit for both sides. Symmetric first hit +/-X, else held bid at horizon. No fee, spread or slippage in labels. Native quotes, exact integer prices, first event wins; common horizon feedback maturity. Censored is unknown. Actual quote overshoot retained in unit PnL but clipped event reward stays in [-1,1].

expert_selection.criterion: Mean signed first-event reward shrunk by n/(n+20), support on both previous days; select highest with score>=0.1. No equity, dollars, position size, or overshoot in selection.

risk.affordability: Require cash>=X*100*requested_multiplier; never increase stake beyond remaining planned loss budget. No borrowing or deposit replenishment. Insufficient capital is distinct from actual bankruptcy.

post_cost.contract: Freeze bid-defined entry signal and price-event/time exit request. Execute both sides at BBO with latency, validating support. If entry follows trigger, request close after entry. Fees change PnL but never labels, ranking, or fixed price-event exits.

scope: Previously inspected 22-day atlas cohort requiring old completed zone visits. Initial ten days fit frozen models; prior-pair, expanding and blended models use only mature prior days. Primary eight forward days plus separate two-day extension. Finite preregistered variants, not a search optimized on future results. Equity and martingale are post-evaluation only. Zero-cost bid is a common research price, not executable LONG trading. No live or persistent edge admission.
